Which jar to take

A serving is about 5 g, a heaped teaspoon. The larger the jar, the less each 10 g costs.

Three days once it is open

Unopened, a jar keeps three months in the fridge at 0 to 4 °C. Opened, eat it within three days. For two people over a week, two 30 g jars taste better than one 50 g.
